sentences: Otto, who had arrived last, jogged to catch up with the others, his boots squelching in the mud.
Ivo arrived a few minutes before Uma, both carrying binoculars slung around their necks, while Dara showed up shortly after with a battered field guide tucked under one arm.
Everyone gathered near the wooden gate to check their gear before setting off toward the trees.
contradictions.explanation: Otto is said to have arrived last and jogged to catch up after the group set off, yet he also brought the first-aid kit and gathered with everyone at the wooden gate before departing, implying he was present from the start.
